name: Action item tracker
summary: Every action with one owner and a due date, linked to the meeting, decision or project it came from, with a weekly review and a way to close it with proof.
description: A tracker for the actions that come out of meetings, projects, audits and customer requests: six statuses, a priority, an owner, a due date, a follow-up date, a decision log and a check after corrective actions. Reminders come from automation rules and notifications.

prompt.intro: Set up an action item tracker in my Customermates workspace: actions with six statuses, a priority, an owner, a due date and a follow-up date, linked to meetings, decisions and projects, plus a weekly review.
questions: Where do your actions come from: meetings, projects, audits, customers?
Who owns actions, and who decides when one is re-dated or cancelled?
Do you need corrective and preventive actions with an effectiveness check, as in ISO 9001?
Do you keep minutes elsewhere? Only a link to them is kept here.
